observations: Photo 0: Automatic transmission casing lying on brick paving with a separate torque converter beside it; white label shows '460'; watermark 'FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL LIMITED'.
Photo 1: Close-up of torque converter showing internal turbine fins and central hub.
Photo 2: Transmission from another angle showing bell housing, casing ribs, mounting points, and oil stains on the ground.

claims.claim: M278 1282 OEM G63 Mercedes transmission gearbox
claims.evidence: Model code M278 and G63 are not legible in any photo; no Mercedes badge or plate is visible.
Photos show exterior only; no operation, test drive, or shifting is shown.

risks.risk: Internal transmission damage or failure not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox shifting through gears or installed and running in a vehicle

risks.risk: Torque converter internal damage or contaminated fluid
risks.proof: Converter spin test or cutaway inspection showing intact fins and clean fluid

risks.risk: Oil leaks from seals or casing cracks
risks.proof: Pressure test or cleaned underside photo showing all fluid ports

risks.risk: Missing components such as mechatronic unit, mounts, or bell-housing hardware
risks.proof: Complete inventory photo showing all ports and attachments

proof_requests: Video of the gearbox operating or installed in a car shifting through gears
Clear photo of any identification plate showing the full part number
Photo of the underside and all fluid ports to check for leaks
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an automatic transmission gearbox from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (not working) despite the unverified model and function claims.
